sources.title: [FICTIONAL DEMO] Energy Reporting Rule
sources.raw_text: Section 2(a). Covered providers must maintain an annual compliance record. Section 4(b). Each licensed provider must submit an annual energy-use report no later than March 31.

evidence.snippet: Covered providers must maintain an annual compliance record.
Each licensed provider must submit an annual energy-use report no later than March 31.

steps.title: Understand the policy

claims.text: The text creates annual recordkeeping duties for covered providers and annual reporting duties for licensed providers.
claims.original_text: The rule creates annual recordkeeping and reporting duties for covered or licensed providers.
claims.verification_note: The original wording blurred two labels used by the source: covered providers and licensed providers. The revised text keeps the duties separate.

steps.ai_output: The fictional rule creates annual compliance recordkeeping and energy-use reporting duties.

steps.title: Identify major provisions

claims.text: Licensed providers must submit an annual energy-use report by March 31.
Licensed providers must submit energy-use reports every month.
claims.verification_note: The cited text says annual, not monthly.

steps.ai_output: A major provision is the annual March 31 reporting requirement for licensed providers.
